description: Hey everyone! We’re tackling "Abandoned but not Forgotten" to share the incredible stories behind NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. I’m a dedicated team player with skills in research, brainstorming, and project management. summary: Space Relics is an interactive HTML and JavaScript application that teaches students about NASA equipment left on the moon and mars. It combines NASA images, equipment stories, a rover navigation game, lunar distance calculator, and quizzes. The project addresses the challenge by explaining how this hardware enabled scientific discoveries, preserving its educational preserving its educational value and inspiring curiosity about space exploration.
details: Space relics teaches student about NASA equipment left on the moon and mars through stories , NASA ,images, a rover game , a lunar distance calculator , and quizzes , built with HTML,CSS and Javascript with ChatGPT/codex assistance, it works offline without and account.
